title: 2023 Panini Prizm #93 Russell Wilson Denver Broncos Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This is a 2023 Panini Prizm trading card featuring Russell Wilson, the quarterback for the Denver Broncos. The card is part of the base set and has the card number 93. It is a standard size card and was manufactured in the United States.

The card is a rookie card and comes with Donruss autograph authentication. It is a National Football League (NFL) card and is perfect for collectors who love football. The card is not autographed and is a Prizm parallel/variety. The description is in English and the card is a must-have for fans of Russell Wilson and the Denver Broncos.
